sections.title: Next action checklist page
sections.what: Builds the checklist from the case guidance. It shows a summary of items ready to review, a status label for each item, and an empty message when there is no guidance.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond showing what the user should do next.
sections.watch_out: Checkbox choices are not saved, so a refresh clears them.

summary: Shows a checklist of guidance items for the case and how many are ready to review.
purpose: Tells the user what to do next and which guidance items are ready.
why: Likely reason: it supports the preparation workflow by turning guidance items into a clear next step.
how: Gets the guidance items from the case and splits them by status. If there are none, it shows an empty message. Otherwise it shows a summary card and a list. Checkbox state is kept in memory only.
inputs: Guidance items from the case detail, the chosen language, and user clicks on checkboxes.
outputs: A summary of ready items, a status label for each item, and an empty message when there is no guidance.
risks: Checkbox state lives only in browser memory, so it resets on refresh. The rendering line is cut off in the packet.
debug: If the list is empty, check the guidance data on the case. If status labels are wrong, check the status values in the guidance type. If checkmarks disappear, that is expected after a page refresh.
